name: day1-initial
description: D4-2 product-scope proposal. Not an active runtime configuration or an approved D4-3 generation input.
token_scope_note: These token files expand approve/transfer targets only. They are not an allowlist for Permit2 message tokens, NFPM token pairs, or Morpho market parameters.

proposed_request_paths.verification: DEC-01/03 raw request to Action; DEC-02 raw approve to policy verdict
limits: No expansion to other ERC-20 targets
Existing gas metadata contains a Pyth stub
No cryptographic verification of the user's EIP-712 signature

proposed_request_paths.verification: DEC-05 v3 decoding and legacy diagnostic fixtures
limits: No full EIP-712 consistency or signature verification
Nonce model, malformed fallback, uint160/uint48 ranges and large times remain uncorrected

proposed_request_paths.verification: DEC-06a/06c fixture decoding, ordering and partial diagnostics
limits: Pool state/current price are placeholders and pool address is calculated locally
Nested live_inputs declarations must be inventoried; null handoff live_inputs_ref does not imply absence
No proof of EVM execution or actual child msg.value

proposed_request_paths.target_scope: source concrete Bundler3 and GeneralAdapter1 deployments
proposed_request_paths.verification: DEC-06b/06c Call[] and callback fixture decoding
limits: No callback authentication or proof of EVM execution
SupplyCollateral live_inputs are a skeleton; enrichment remains deferred

multicall.result: Keep decoded order plus Unknown/partial diagnostics for unregistered or limit-truncated segments
multicall.whole_request_errors: Malformed ABI/emit, missing required inputs and short self children remain whole-request errors; do not recover them as Unknown/partial

policy_scope.action_to_verdict: D3 covers all five policies using the existing WASM evaluator
policy_scope.swap_raw_decoder: deferred; shipping the policy source does not provide a swap decoder
policy_scope.live_dto_inputs: Not eliminated by external_fact_methods being empty

deferred: Additional ERC-20 targets/chains beyond the selected expansion inputs
Swap raw decoding, pool resolver and live-input validation
Permit2 strict EIP-712 and existing v3 model corrections
USDC Permit/Permit2 transaction routes (index presence is not decoder coverage)
Source-context materialization and dynamic bundle discovery/install
Publisher signatures, Core runtime and SDK independent build
d4_3_requirements: Do not consume this proposal until the product scope decision is recorded
Resolve the explicit source keys and exact token inputs; do not follow future selection additions automatically
Record the distinction between artifact/index inclusion and supported request paths; existing permit calldata entries are not approved transaction support
Inventory nested live_inputs declarations and distinguish generation dependencies from runtime data requirements
Pin generation inputs and implement reproducible output, per-bundle JCS digests and a separate local snapshot digest
Core must respect supported request paths; artifact installation alone is not runtime acceptance or product release verification
